subject: Re: Atlas reference call — scheduling + brief
body:
----- Message 1 of 6 -----
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@atlasinsurance.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Oct 11, 2025 at 9:18 AM
Subject: Atlas reference call — scheduling

Hi Maya,

Wanted to see if Atlas would be open to a 30-min reference call with a prospective customer evaluating Redwood Dedicated for a document summarization + RAG workload.

If yes, could you share a few windows next week? We’ll keep this lightweight and we’ll send a brief ahead of time so there are no surprises.

Suggested windows (PT):
- Tue 10/14: 10:00–12:00
- Wed 10/15: 1:00–3:00
- Thu 10/16: 9:00–11:00

Also confirming: we’ll avoid any discussion of your vendor selection process / commercial terms, and we can keep metrics at a high level if preferred.

Thanks again — really appreciate it.

Priyom

—
Priyom Das
Enterprise Programs | Redwood Inference


----- Message 2 of 6 -----
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@atlasinsurance.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Oct 11, 2025 at 12:06 PM
Subject: Re: Atlas reference call — scheduling

Hi Priyom,

Yes, happy to do a reference call.

Availability next week (PT):
- Tue 10/14 10:30–11:00
- Wed 10/15 1:30–2:00

Couple of constraints:
1) We can’t share exact $/token or contract details.
2) We can talk about performance targets and what we measured, but prefer ranges vs exact numbers.

If it helps, Jonah (copied) can join as well. He owns our platform reliability work.

Maya


----- Message 3 of 6 -----
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@atlasinsurance.com>
Cc: Jonah Reed <jonah.reed@atlasinsurance.com>, Avery Johnson <avery@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>, Miguel Santos <miguel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Oct 11, 2025 at 12:41 PM
Subject: Re: Atlas reference call — scheduling + brief

Perfect — thank you.

Let’s lock Wed 10/15 from 1:30–2:00pm PT.

Attached is a short reference-call brief so you can see what the prospect is trying to learn and what we’ll steer away from.

Attachment: Atlas_Reference_Call_Brief_Redwood_v1.pdf

Likely prospect questions (so you can prep at a glance):
- What drove you to move to Dedicated vs continuing on shared endpoints?
- How did you validate latency/throughput under your real traffic patterns?
- What did rollout look like (canary, fallback policies, model pinning)?
- How do you think about reliability (SLOs, incident response, graceful degradation)?
- What does day-2 ops look like (dashboards, tracing, cost visibility, alerting)?
- Any gotchas integrating (auth/networking, SDK/API changes, prompt/eval workflows)?

We’ll also open with 1–2 minutes of context from the prospect so you’re not guessing.

Next step: I’ll send the calendar invite + conferencing shortly.

Thanks again,
Priyom


----- Message 4 of 6 -----
From: Jonah Reed <jonah.reed@atlasinsurance.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@atlasinsurance.com>, Avery Johnson <avery@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>, Miguel Santos <miguel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Oct 12, 2025 at 8:22 AM
Subject: Re: Atlas reference call — scheduling + brief

Priyom,

Sounds good. One more request from our side:

Please avoid naming any other vendors we evaluated (even if the prospect asks). We can speak to requirements and outcomes, just not who we compared against.

Otherwise the outline looks fine.

Jonah


----- Message 5 of 6 -----
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonah Reed <jonah.reed@atlasinsurance.com>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@atlasinsurance.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>, Miguel Santos <miguel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Oct 12, 2025 at 9:03 AM
Subject: Re: Atlas reference call — scheduling + brief

Totally understood — we’ll steer away from vendor names and commercial details.

Calendar invite coming through now:
- When: Wed 10/15 1:30–2:00pm PT
- Where: Redwood Google Meet (link in invite)

Quick agenda:
1) 2 min prospect context
2) 20 min Atlas experience (implementation + ops)
3) 8 min Q&A

If you’d like, we can also do a 5-min pre-brief with you right before to confirm what to emphasize.

Priyom


----- Message 6 of 6 -----
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@atlasinsurance.com>, Jonah Reed <jonah.reed@atlasinsurance.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Oct 14, 2025 at 4:37 PM
Subject: Reminder: Atlas reference call tomorrow (Wed 1:30pm PT)

Hi Maya/Jonah,

Reminder for tomorrow’s reference call at 1:30pm PT. The Meet link is in the calendar invite.

Two last notes based on the prospect’s prep:
- They care most about how you handled traffic spikes / queueing, and what you did when capacity got tight.
- They’ll likely ask about "what happens when the primary model is overloaded" — feel free to keep that high-level (policy + outcomes, no sensitive config).

Thanks again — we really appreciate you both making time.

Priyom
